title: Oscar and the Wolf
author: Odile Oyelaran
blurb: Wendell Amberdale, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
